name: US NIST AI 600-1: GenAI / 生成式 AI 风险 (draft)
description: Voluntary GenAI profile subset: grounded output checks, red teaming, provenance and human review. Complements, rather than replaces, the existing AI RMF lifecycle pack.

sources.title: NIST AI 600-1 Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile

limitations: Voluntary, unreviewed partial mapping; not US law, NIST certification or complete coverage of the profile's risk categories and suggested actions.
Tests and documents must be supplied. No fact is produced merely by installing this pack; no detector can establish absence of hallucination, bias or privacy risk.

Booleans assert availability of evidence, not independently verified quality or test success. Scope remains a human judgment. The 30-day freshness interval is local assurance policy, not a NIST mandate.

controls.title: Review GenAI scope and risk priorities
controls.remediation: Document use cases and selected risks; justify omitted risk areas.

controls.title: Output citation checks recorded
controls.remediation: Retain sampled output/source checks and failure analysis.

controls.title: GenAI red-team evidence recorded
controls.remediation: Reference injection, extraction and misuse tests with versioned results.

controls.title: Training and evaluation provenance recorded
controls.remediation: Reference provenance and retrieval-data grounding records.

controls.title: Review measurement limits
controls.remediation: Review representativeness before generalising test results.
